docket_entries.description: PERSONAL INJURY/PROPERTY DAMAGE - VEHICLE RELATED, COMPLAINT FILED BY PLAINTIFF KHELIFI, KARIM AS TO DEFENDANT STOSIC, DAMIR WORLD OMNI FINANCIAL CORP.
